  ROUND(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) / SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct,

  SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS net_paid,
  COUNT(*) AS sales_rows,
  COUNT(sr.sr_ticket_number) AS matched_return_rows
FROM store_sales ss
